title: Louisiana Starlink hold: 10,635 planned locations remain future coverage rather than accepted service
publisher: Louisiana Office of Broadband Development and Connectivity
summary: ConnectLA's agreement describes service for 10,635 locations by the end of summer but still does not provide an activated-location roster, subscriber adoption, tests, price, complaints, retention, or accepted closeout. Denominator: The 10,635-location agreement cohort, preserved as planned coverage until location-level activation and operating evidence are published.
key_findings: Evidence stage: Adoption and activation hold.

Finding: ConnectLA's agreement describes service for 10,635 locations by the end of summer but still does not provide an activated-location roster, subscriber adoption, tests, price, complaints, retention, or accepted closeout.
Denominator: The 10,635-location agreement cohort, preserved as planned coverage until location-level activation and operating evidence are published.
Boundary: An agreement and future coverage date are not activated service.
Boundary: Planned locations are not subscribers or retained users.
Boundary: No activation, test, latency, uptime, price, affordability, complaint, retention, or closeout series is public.
Next action: Reopen with location-level activation, installation, subscriber, test, latency, uptime, price, affordability, complaint, retention, and accepted-closeout records.
why_it_matters: The visible hold prevents repeated inventories, plans, serviceability, capacity, or component data from being presented as reliability, adoption, accepted output, recurring rate, or a complete program baseline.
